result.title: Infrastructure-Based Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Attention for Highway Ramp Merging
result.summary: On-ramp merging is a typical safety and throughput problem on highways. Without proper coordination, human drivers and self-interested autonomous vehicles may make risky manoeuvres and cause accidents or congestion. With recent advances in connected autonomous vehicles (CAVs) and multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), vehicles can be trained to coordinate for safe and efficient merging. However, in dense traffic, forming an effective observation of the traffic state is challenging. For example, observing only the neighbouring vehicles may lead to locally optimal decisions, while observing the entire traffic can introduce much irrelevant information. In this paper, we propose a transformer-based MARL vehicle control model to address these problems. A roadside infrastructure controller receives the states of all CAVs via vehicle-to-infrastructure (V2I) communication and sends control commands back to them. An attention-based observation encoder is designed where each vehicle can filter the relevant vehicle information from the global traffic state. The proposed model is evaluated in SUMO against three baselines: a model that observes only the neighbouring vehicles, a model that encodes the global traffic information, and the rule-based SUMO model. The results show that our model achieves the highest traffic flow, safety and smoothness. Furthermore, in a four-hour simulation with dynamic traffic demand, our model successfully avoids traffic jams, while other baseline models fail at high traffic flow. We also show that our model remains effective when human-driven vehicles are present. We further show that our model, trained in ideal communication conditions, can still remain collision-free and maintain throughput under realistic V2I communication errors. Finally, we visualise the relevance weights that an ego vehicle assigns to other vehicles in multiple traffic situations.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究高速公路匝道合流，提出由路侧基础设施汇集所有联网车辆状态、再用 transformer 注意力编码器筛选相关车辆信息并下发控制指令的多智能体强化学习模型，在 SUMO 中对比邻车观测、全局观测和规则基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「从全局状态中学习筛选任务相关信息并可视化相关性权重」的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与冗余信息抑制提供可供核查的方法线索，但场景与多模态推理相距较远。
